record.what_it_does: Cloud communications APIs: SMS, voice, messaging, verify, video, numbers.
record.auth_notes:
Only account-level credentials are available:
- API key/secret, sent as a Basic Authorization header or as parameters on legacy APIs.
- JWT signed with RS256 using an application ID and private key. Docs recommend JWT for most uses, including Messages and Verify.
- Digest auth (key as username, secret as password) for SIP trunking.
- Signed SMS requests, which use SIGNATURE_SECRET instead of API_SECRET.

There is no OAuth2 delegated flow for third parties, so each end user must supply their own key/secret or application ID plus private key.
record.access_notes:
Sign-up is self-serve and new accounts get a small free credit (docs cite €2) in DEMO mode. While in demo mode:
- SMS can only go to the registered number plus a few whitelisted test numbers. Sources disagree on the count (4, 5 or 10).
- Voice calls can only go to the registered number.
- Trial SMS messages are tagged [FREE SMS DEMO, TEST MESSAGE].
- Trial credit cannot buy virtual numbers.

Adding funds converts the account to paid pay-as-you-go and lifts the limits. There is no app review and no plan tier gate.
record.api_breadth_notes:
The API reference lists these APIs:
- Messages, Dispatch, SMS, External Accounts, WhatsApp Provisioning, Conversation, Alerts and 2FA.
- Voice (with NCCO and Voice Webhooks) and Media.
- Identity Insights and Device Location.
- Application and Reports.
- Number Management, Number Pools and US Number Deactivation.
- Account and Pricing.
- Verify, including custom templates.
- Redact and Audit.

Video is also offered. Each API reference page has OpenAPI YAML/JSON downloads.
record.mcp_notes:
Vonage publishes two official MCP servers:
- **Server API Bindings (Tooling) MCP server:** npm `@vonage/vonage-mcp-server-api-bindings`. It runs locally over stdio via npx and needs VONAGE_API_KEY/SECRET, APPLICATION_ID and PRIVATE_KEY64 set as environment variables. This is the one that can call the APIs.
- **Documentation MCP server:** hosted remotely at https://documentation-mcp.vonage.dev/mcp (HTTP). It only serves documentation and cannot call any APIs.
record.blocker_notes: There is no OAuth2, so users must paste an API key/secret or an application ID plus private key for JWT. Real sending beyond whitelisted test numbers requires topping up the account with credit, and trial credit is small. A free Messages API Sandbox (WhatsApp, Viber, Messenger, Instagram) helps with testing.
